scope: post-result exploratory allocation experiment; not an untouched holdout or original-paper replication
primary_comparison: buffer XGB minus hard XGB, 5bp and one additional session delay
secondary_comparisons: adjacent variants, XGB minus LR, and buffer versus basic minimum variance; all published, no best-variant promotion
probability_rule: p0 * mu0 + (1-p0) * min(mu1,-0.001); the original bearish cap remains fixed to isolate probability weighting
buffer_rule: Keep the drifted current weights when proposed risky-leg L1 turnover is below 2% of NAV; forced cash and correction of an existing weight-cap breach override the buffer
fixed_conditions: Frozen controlled forecasts, shared lambda and h=4, 11-year rolling training, 5-year sequential validation, biannual refits, 40% per-asset cap, no leverage/shorts, original global cash rule and optimizer
limitations: Existing Korean evaluation performance was observed before this design.
Stock dividends and USD interest remain excluded; no synthetic filling is introduced.
Delay 0 retains the idealized signal-close convention. Delay 1 uses the preceding session's decision inputs and the current drifted holdings at execution.
Bootstrap is conditional on frozen forecasts and does not adjust for multiple comparisons or model refitting.
Classifier retraining, probability calibration, new total-return data and a new asset universe are outside this allocation-only phase.
